title: Kerusi Map
description: A reusable physical seating configuration: one canvas, a seat size, legend, price tiers, sections, seats, and non-bookable elements (Kerusi v1.0, RFC section 4).

kerusi.description: Spec version this document conforms to (section 7).

id.description: Unique id for this map, e.g. 'cinema3-hallA'. Names the physical configuration, not an event (section 3).

domain.$comment: Non-normative (section 4): a consumer MUST NOT reject a document, and MUST NOT alter required-field validation, on the basis of its domain value. Deliberately NOT constrained to an enum, since an enum would reject conformant documents carrying an unlisted domain hint.

locale.$comment: Full BCP-47 well-formedness is not enforced here; a validator MAY check it separately.

seatSize.description: A seat's footprint: a square of this side, in canvas units, centred on the seat's x/y and turned by its rotation (section 4.5). A section MAY override it.

legend.description: Vocabulary of seat types used in this map (section 4.7).
legend.$comment: No minItems: section 4 declares legend REQUIRED but states no lower bound. A map whose sections hold no seats legitimately needs no seat types.

priceTiers.$comment: Section 4.9: a KerusiMap MUST NOT mix currencies across seats; exactly one currency value applies to the whole map. Cross-checking every PriceTier.price.currency and Seat.price.currency for equality is beyond JSON Schema and MUST be enforced by a custom validator.

$comment: This schema enforces the structural rules of section 4 that JSON Schema can express. Referential integrity (section 4.6), positions within the canvas (section 4.3.1), row/col uniqueness (section 4.3.5), row shape column ranges (section 4.2.3), companions symmetry (section 4.6), identifier uniqueness (sections 4.3 and 4.6), and single-currency consistency (section 4.9) require a custom validator in addition to this schema: schema/validator.mjs runs this schema and then those rules. See schema/README.md.

LocalizableString.description: A plain string, or a locale map such as { "en": "Orchestra", "ms": "Orkestra" }.

Canvas.title: Canvas
Canvas.description: The one drawing surface of a map (section 4.5). Abstract units with the same scale on both axes; the origin is the top-left corner, x grows to the right and y grows downwards.

SeatSize.description: The side of a seat's square footprint, in canvas units (section 4.5).

ColRange.description: [first, last]: the columns a row shape spans (section 4.2.3).
ColRange.$comment: first MUST NOT exceed last; comparing the two items is beyond JSON Schema and is enforced by a custom validator.

Bounds.title: Bounds
Bounds.description: A rectangle on the canvas: top-left corner and size, in canvas units (section 4.1).

Money.title: Money
Money.description: An amount in minor units plus an ISO 4217 currency (section 4.8).

amount.description: Minor units (e.g. cents), to avoid floating-point error.

id.$comment: Uniqueness within legend is not expressible in JSON Schema; enforce with a custom validator. A duplicate makes Seat.type, and through defaultPriceTier a seat's price (section 4.9), ambiguous.

color.description: Suggested render colour, hex. Non-normative hint.

defaultPriceTier.$comment: MUST resolve against KerusiMap.priceTiers[].id (section 4.9 step 3). Cross-collection reference; enforce with a custom validator.

PriceTier.title: PriceTier
PriceTier.description: A named price tier referenced by id (section 4.8).

id.$comment: Uniqueness within priceTiers is not expressible in JSON Schema; enforce with a custom validator.

Accessibility.title: Accessibility
Accessibility.description: Structured accessibility properties (section 4.3.4). All members are OPTIONAL.

RowShape.title: RowShape
RowShape.description: Exactly one of line, arc or circle: a guide recording the form a row was laid out in, for editors (section 4.2.3). It MUST NOT move any seat.

start.description: Degrees on the canvas axes: 0 points right, 90 points down.

sweep.description: Degrees; positive turns clockwise on screen.

start.description: Degrees on the canvas axes: 0 points right, 90 points down.

RowMeta.title: RowMeta
RowMeta.description: A descriptive row registry entry (section 4.2). Not a container: seats live in Section.seats and join a row only through Seat.row.
RowMeta.$comment: A RowMeta that no seat references is valid and reserves no space (section 4.2.2). A validator MUST NOT reject it.

id.$comment: Uniqueness within Section.rows is not expressible in JSON Schema; enforce with a custom validator. Two sections MAY each declare a row with the same id, since row references are section-scoped.

index.description: Ordering key among rows in the section, not a position (section 4.2.1).

Direction.title: Direction
Direction.description: An optional, purely informational label pair for one axis (section 4.10).
Direction.$comment: Non-normative: MUST NOT be used by a validator to reject a document, and MUST NOT be relied upon by a renderer to decide layout or screen placement (section 4.10).

Seat.title: Seat
Seat.description: A bookable seat (section 4.3). It is drawn at its x/y; row and col say only which seats are its neighbours.
Seat.$comment: Not expressible in JSON Schema, and enforced by a custom validator: x MUST NOT exceed canvas.width nor y canvas.height (section 4.3.1); no two seats in a section share the same row and col (section 4.3.5); and referential integrity (section 4.6) - Seat.type MUST resolve against KerusiMap.legend[].id; Seat.priceTier against KerusiMap.priceTiers[].id; Seat.row against Section.rows[].id when Section.rows is present (opaque free text otherwise); Seat.companions[] against other Seat.id values within the same section, fully symmetric.

id.$comment: Uniqueness across all sections is not expressible in JSON Schema; enforce with a custom validator.

row.description: The seat's row. Membership is by this field alone, never by position (section 4.2.3).

col.description: Adjacency ordinal within the row: seats in the same row whose cols differ by 1 are neighbours (section 4.3.5). Never places the seat.

x.description: Centre of the seat's footprint, in canvas units, 0 to canvas.width (section 4.3.1).

y.description: Centre of the seat's footprint, in canvas units, 0 to canvas.height (section 4.3.1).

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise on screen, about the seat's centre.

type.description: References a SeatType.id in the map's legend. Mutually exclusive: a seat has exactly one type (section 4.3.3).

price.description: Literal override; takes precedence over priceTier (section 4.9).

attributes.description: Zero or more non-exclusive tags. MUST NOT independently affect price (section 4.3.3).

Element.title: Element
Element.description: A non-bookable feature that still requires rendering: screen, stage, exit, lavatory, staircase, or a labelled gap (section 4.4). Placed on the canvas exactly as a seat is.
Element.$comment: x MUST NOT exceed canvas.width nor y canvas.height (section 4.4.1); enforced by a custom validator.

id.description: Unique within the KerusiMap, across all sections (section 4.6).
id.$comment: Uniqueness across all sections is not expressible in JSON Schema; enforce with a custom validator.

width.description: Canvas units. Default: the applicable seatSize (section 4.4.1).

height.description: Canvas units. Default: the applicable seatSize (section 4.4.1).

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise on screen, about the element's centre.

Section.title: Section
Section.description: A named zone on the map's canvas: a flat list of seats plus an optional row registry and elements (section 4.1). Not a canvas of its own.

id.$comment: Uniqueness across the map's sections is not expressible in JSON Schema; enforce with a custom validator.

index.description: Ordering key among sections, not a position (section 4.1.1).
index.$comment: Section order (section 4.1.1): sections declaring index first, ascending; sections with no index after them in declaration order; ties keep declaration order. The same rule as RowMeta.index (section 4.2.1).

seatSize.description: Overrides KerusiMap.seatSize for this section's seats and elements (section 4.5).

bounds.description: The section's extent on the canvas, for zooming, thumbnails and legends. Does not affect drawing; the section's seats SHOULD lie inside it (section 4.1).

rows.$comment: When present, this is the section's complete, ordered row registry: every Seat.row MUST resolve against it (sections 4.2 and 4.6).

seats.description: Flat list; order is not significant (section 4.1).
seats.$comment: No minItems: section 4.1 declares seats REQUIRED but states no lower bound, so a section that holds only elements - a stage or a screen with no seats of its own - is valid.
